name: Andrew Garfield
profileSummary: Andrew Russell Garfield is an English and American actor. Known for his work in a variety of genres, from biographical-dramas to action in independent films. His accolades includes two Critics' Choice Awards, a Golden Globe Award and a British Academy Television Award, in addition to nominations for two Academy Awards, three British Academy Film Awards and a Primetime Emmy Award. In 2022, Time magazine named him one of the 100 most influential people in the world.
